explication: LANDrop is a Qt desktop app for discovering devices on a local network and transferring files between them. The user selects files, chooses a discovered recipient (or enters an address), and starts a transfer; incoming transfers are reviewed and saved locally. The graph includes the tray-driven app, discovery, transfer protocol and UI, settings, and cryptography. Some subsystem links rely on the source index or README because not all implementation files were excerpted; those links are cited only where the available evidence supports them.
